description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 11.02.2019 to 17.02.2019
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and concerns the determination of official exchange rates for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically addressing how customs valuations and payments should be calculated. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it establishes compliance requirements and modifies previous regulations (by rescinding the previous notification).
